comparison.objective: Add and close a personal padlock on a group lockout hasp without disturbing a coworker's lock; candidate transfers a bearing block.
comparison.physical_skill: Record threads a shackle through a free hasp hole and snaps it shut around existing hardware. Candidate butts aligned support profiles and slides an uncaged block across their junction.
comparison.success_condition: Record requires independent lockout retention under pry and switch tests while the existing lock remains undisturbed. Candidate requires complete transfer, continuous support and zero lost balls.
comparison.reason: Shackle insertion and safety-lock verification do not test rolling-element circulation or containment.
